name: @pipeworx/mcp-json

tools.name: validate_json
tools.description: Validate a JSON string (keyless, offline). Returns whether it is valid and, if not, the error message and the character position.

tools.name: format_json
tools.description: Pretty-print or minify a JSON string. `indent` sets spaces (default 2); pass 0 to minify to a single line. Keyless, offline.

tools.name: query_json
tools.description: Extract a value from JSON at a path using dot/bracket notation, e.g. "user.addresses[0].city". Keyless, offline.

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-json forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the json pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
